title: TinyFish Search & Fetch input
description: Search the web, or read pages as clean Markdown, HTML, or JSON. Field names match the TinyFish Search and Fetch APIs.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to do: "search" finds pages for a query, "fetch" reads the pages at the URLs you give.

query.title: Search query
query.description: What to search the web for. Used in "search" mode.

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Pages to read. Each must be an http or https URL. Pages that need JavaScript are rendered. Used in "fetch" mode. Up to 100 per run.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Why you are making this request: the goal the results will be used for. Optional, and improves result quality.
purpose.example: Compare pricing tiers across vendors for a procurement report

location.title: Location
location.description: Country code for geo-targeted results, such as "US", "GB" or "DE". Resolved from `language` when omitted.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code for results, such as "en", "fr" or "de". Resolved from `location` when omitted.

include_domains.title: Include domains
include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains.

exclude_domains.title: Exclude domains
exclude_domains.description: Never return results from these domains.

domain_type.title: Search type
domain_type.description: "web" for standard results, "news" for news articles with publisher and date, "research_paper" for academic papers with authors, venue and citation count. Defaults to "web".

recency_minutes.title: Recency (minutes)
recency_minutes.description: Only return results from the past N minutes, such as 60 for the last hour. Cannot be combined with `after_date` or `before_date`.

after_date.title: After date
after_date.description: Only return results after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

before_date.title: Before date
before_date.description: Only return results before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

pub_year_min.title: Earliest publication year
pub_year_min.description: Only return papers published in or after this year. Only for the "research_paper" search type.

pub_year_max.title: Latest publication year
pub_year_max.description: Only return papers published in or before this year. Only for the "research_paper" search type.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page of results to return, starting from 0.

format.title: Format
format.description: Format of each page's `text`: "markdown" (recommended for LLMs), "html" for cleaned semantic HTML, or "json" for a structured document tree. Defaults to "markdown".

links.title: Include links
links.description: Also return every link (`<a href>`) found on each page.

image_links.title: Include image links
image_links.description: Also return every image URL (``) found on each page.

iframe_links.title: Include iframe links
iframe_links.description: Also return the `src` of every `<iframe>` on each page. Useful when a page embeds its main content in a frame: fetch the returned URL to read it.

ttl.title: Cache tolerance (seconds)
ttl.description: Accept a cached copy of a page younger than this many seconds. 0 forces a live fetch. Omit to accept any cached copy.

per_url_timeout_ms.title: Timeout per URL (ms)
per_url_timeout_ms.description: Time allowed for each URL, in milliseconds. A URL that takes longer comes back as a `timeout` error while the others still complete.

include_selectors.title: Include selectors
include_selectors.description: CSS selectors: only content inside matching elements is returned, such as "article" or "main".

exclude_selectors.title: Exclude selectors
exclude_selectors.description: CSS selectors: matching elements are removed before the content is extracted, such as ".comments".
